assertions.claim: Chapter intro: the section answers only what to do first, next, and what not to do in a sudden emergency.
assertions.cn_span: 突发状况下先做什么、再做什么、什么不要做

assertions.claim: The two counting systems (case-fatality/survival vs money/freedom) are not converted into each other.
Items are ordered descending by frequency × life-death difference between right and wrong action.
assertions.cn_span: 排序按「最常见 × 做对做错的生死差别」从高到低

assertions.claim: 79.2% of cardiac arrests happen at home, so first-aid items primarily target self/spouse/close family.
assertions.cn_span: 心脏骤停有 79.2% 发生在家里

assertions.claim: For strangers the benefit is not zero but lowest tier, with the downside of being scammed/dragged into a case; self-protection and liability waivers are written first.
assertions.cn_span: 对陌生人不是零收益，但档次最低、还带被讹和被卷进案子的一面
